title: Kenya's graduate jobs gap in 2026, and what it means for employers
description: Kenya created 822,100 jobs in 2025, but only about 105,000 were formal. With a million young people entering the labour market every year, here is what the 2026 data says about hiring, and why the best graduates are being overlooked.

cover.caption: Graduation day in Nairobi.
